content.about: Montenegro is a small country on the Adriatic, where steep mountains drop straight into the sea. Its name means "Black Mountain". The Bay of Kotor winds inland like a fjord, lined with old stone towns. Lake Skadar is home to pelicans.

standout.text: The Tara River Canyon is one of the deepest canyons in Europe, about 1,300 m deep.

didYouKnow: Montenegro uses the euro without being in the eurozone.
Kotor's old town walls climb the mountain behind it.
The Ostrog Monastery is built into a vertical cliff.
